capabilities: Show a token count for the active note in the status bar
Choose the tokenizer model (gpt-5, gpt-4o, gpt-4, claude, or gemini)
Update the count live as the note is edited
Optionally display the model name next to the count
extras: Desktop only; the first Gemini count downloads a vocabulary file and requires network; counts include YAML frontmatter; not reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's built-in word count doesn't show how many tokens a note would use in an LLM context window.
summary: Status-bar token counter that estimates the active note's LLM token count using GPT, Claude, or Gemini tokenizers.
